Good taste and atmosphere
May 2026 • Solo
Finding a quality craft beer bar Saigon can be a bit of a challenge if you want to avoid the loud music and the mid tourist traps of District 1. I found After Six while searching for craft beer near me on a quiet Tuesday evening and it was exactly what I needed. Located in a small alley at 25/22 Ton That Tung, this place feels like a hidden sanctuary for any true beer lover. They have a curated selection of about 7 taps of fresh draft craft beer and I highkey love how they focus on quality distributors rather than just mass volume. I decided to go for the beer flight tasting so I could sample a few different styles. The standout for me was the Hanoi Autumn which is a signature local craft beer Vietnam. It is a pilsner base but infused with Vong green rice and pandan leaves, giving it a beer flavor profile that is incredibly aromatic and smooth. It is straight up bussin and so much more refreshing than the industrial beer brands in vietnam. The staff are very welcoming and clearly know their hops malt yeast beer basics. If you are exploring craft beer Ho Chi Minh and want a well rounded and memorable experience, this is the place. It is a perfect chill bar craft beer Saigon for people in their 20s to 40s who just want to enjoy a quality beer drink.

Good Vietnamese Beer craft
May 2026 • Solo
Finding a high quality craft beer bar Saigon can be a lowkey daunting task if you are not familiar with the city and its hidden alleyway culture. Most tourists end up at the loud overpriced venues on the main streets which are honestly so mid. But as someone in my late 30s I highkey prefer a more refined and peaceful atmosphere where the focus remains on the liquid in the glass. I found After Six while searching for craft beer near me on a quiet Tuesday evening and it turned out to be the absolute highlight of my trip to Ho Chi Minh City. Located at 25/22 Ton That Tung this place is a masterclass in curation passing the vibe check perfectly. Unlike many other bars that try to offer too many mediocre options After Six focuses on a tight high quality selection of 5 to 7 types of local craft beer Vietnam. What truly sets them apart is their dedication to the Vietnamese craft beer scene through their rotating seasonal taps. These brews change based on the local agricultural harvests meaning you get a fresh taste of the land with every visit which is a massive W. I spent a long evening here starting with a beer flight tasting and the standout was definitely the Hanoi Autumn. It is built on a classic pilsner base but infused with Vong green rice and pandan leaves creating a beer flavor profile that is incredibly aromatic smooth and nostalgic. It literally hits different. The first sip brings a grassy sweet scent of the rice fields followed by the creamy finish of pandan. It is leagues ahead of the standard industrial beer brands in vietnam that you find in every convenience store. The staff are exceptionally knowledgeable about the hops malt yeast beer components and can explain the story behind every distributor they work with. If you are exploring craft beer Ho Chi Minh and want a well rounded and memorable experience After Six is the destination. It is the perfect chill bar craft beer Saigon for those who take their beer drinking seriously. This is easily the best craft beer bar District 1 for anyone who values quality atmosphere and authentic local flavors. I will be coming back here every time I visit this city no cap.
